name: incident_test_heuristic_v1
description: Incident Reporting System Test: 5 providers with varying safety investments (0.0 to 0.8), 4 initial benchmarks, heuristic mode (no LLM). Tests incident generation, ecosystem propagation, and regulatory response. EU precautionary policymaker preset for incident-driven intervention testing. 39 consumer segments react to incidents with satisfaction penalties and trust erosion. 3 funders reduce funding to providers with incident history.
